questions.question: If cosec2θ = sec (3θ – 15°), then θ is equal to:
questions.solution:
⇒ cosec 2θ = sec (3θ – 15°),

⇒ cosec 2θ = cosec [90° – (3θ – 15°)] [cosec(90 – θ) = sec θ]

⇒ 2θ = 90° – 3θ + 15°

⇒ θ = 21°

questions.question: Five cubes, each of edge 3 cm are joined end to end. What is the total surface area of the resulting cuboid, in cm²?
questions.solution:
Side of each cube = 3 cm

Five cubes are joined end to end, then length of newly formed cuboid = 3 × 5 = 15 cm

Breadth of newly formed cuboid = 3 cm

Height of newly formed cuboid = 3 cm

As we know,

Total surface area of cuboid = 2 (lb + bh + hl)

⇒ 2 (15 × 3 + 3 × 3 + 3 × 15)

⇒ 2 (45 + 9 + 45)

⇒ 2 × 99

⇒ 198 cm²

questions.question: If (5a – 3b) : (4a – 2b) = 2 : 3, then a : b is equal to:
If a + b + c = 10 and ab + bc + ca = 32 then a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given, a + b + c = 10 and ab + bc + ca = 32

As we know,

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c) [(a + b + c)² – 3(ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 10 [10² – 3 × 32]

⇒ 10 (100 – 96)

⇒ 10 × 4

⇒ 40

questions.question: ΔABC ∼ ΔNLM and ar(ΔABC) : ar(ΔLMN) = 4 : 9. If AB = 6 cm, BC = 8 cm and AC = 12 cm, then ML is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given ΔABC ~ ΔNLM,

⇒ AB = 6 cm, BC = 8 cm, AC = 12 cm and ar(ΔABC) : ar(ΔLMN) = 4/9,

As we know,

⇒ ar(ΔABC)/ar(ΔLMN) = (BC/ML)²

⇒ 8²/ML² = 4/9

⇒ ML² = 8² × 9/4

⇒ ML = 8 × 3/2 = 12 cm

questions.question: If a – b = 5 and ab = 6, then (a³ – b³) is equal to:
questions.solution:
⇒ (a – b)³ = a³ – b³ – 3ab(a – b)

Given, a – b = 5 and ab = 6

⇒ 5³ = (a³ – b³) – 3 × 6 × 5

⇒ (a³ – b³) = 125 + 90 = 215

questions.question: What is the ratio of the total cars sold by showroom B during the years 2014 and 2016 and the total cars sold by showroom C during 2015 and 2016?
questions.solution:
Total cars sold by showroom B during the years 2014 and 2016 = 480 + 400 = 880

Total cars sold by showroom C during the years 2015 and 2016 = 540 + 430 = 970

Required ratio = 880 : 970 = 88 : 97

questions.question: The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio of 5 : 3 : 2. Working together, they can complete a task in 21 hours. In how many hours will B alone complete 40% of that task?
questions.solution:
The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio of 5 : 3 : 2

Total work = (5 + 3 + 2) × 21 = 210

40% of the total work = 210 × 40/100 = 84

40% of the total work completed by B in = 84/3 = 28 hours

questions.question: The price of sugar is increased by 17%. A person wants to increase his expenditure by 5% only. By approximately what percent should he decrease his consumption?
questions.solution:
Let the initial price of sugar be 100x

Price of sugar after increased = 100x × [117 / 100] = 117x

Person wants his expenditure increase by 5% only, so his expenditure should be = 100x × [105 / 100] = 105x

Required percentage = [(117 – 105x) / 117] × 100 = 10.3% (approx)

questions.question: By what percent did the total number of cars sold by all three showrooms decrease during the year 2016, as compared to that in the year 2015 (nearest to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
Total cars sold in the year 2015 = 650 + 520 + 540 = 1710

Total cars sold in the year 2016 = 630 + 400 + 430 = 1460

Required percentage = (1710 – 1460)/1710 × 100 = 14.6% (approx)

questions.question: The value of 15.2 + 5.8 ÷ 2.9 × 2 - 3.5 × 2 ÷ 0.5 is equal to:
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below :

Step-1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first, and in the bracket,

Step-2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

Step-4: Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated. 

⇒ 15.2 + 5.8 ÷ 2.9 × 2 - 3.5 × 2 ÷ 0.5

⇒ 15.2 + 2 × 2 – 3.5 × 4

⇒ 15.2 + 4 – 14

⇒ 19.2 – 14 = 5.2

questions.question: If the total number of cars sold by all three showrooms over the years is represented as a pie-chart, what is the central angle of the sector representing the total number of cars sold in the year 2013 (to the nearest whole number)?
questions.solution:
Total cars sold by showroom A = 500 + 480 + 520 + 620 + 650 + 630 = 3400

Total cars sold by showroom B = 450 + 420 + 530 + 480 + 520 + 400 = 2800

Total cars sold by showroom C = 400 + 450 + 460 + 520 + 540 + 430 = 2800

Total cars sold by all three showrooms = 3400 + 2800 + 2800 = 9000

Cars sold in the year 2013 = 520 + 530 + 460 = 1510

9000 represents = 360°

1510 will represent = 360/9000 × 1510 = 60° (approx)

questions.question: In a class of 50 students, 40% are girls. The average marks of the whole class are 64.4 and the average of the boy’s marks is 62. What is the average mark of the girls?
questions.solution:
Total number of students in the class = 50

Number of girls in class = 50 × 40/100 = 20

Number of boys in class = 50 – 20 = 30

Average marks of whole class = 64.4

Sum of marks of whole class = 64.4 × 50 = 3220

Average marks of boys = 62

Sum of marks of boys = 62 × 30 = 1860

Sum of marks of girls = 3220 – 1860 = 1360

Average marks of girls = 1360/20 = 68

questions.question: What is the value of x so that the seven digit number 8439x53 is divisible by 99?
questions.solution:
Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number divisible by 9 if sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

Divisibility law of 11 : If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because 2 – 3 + 4 – 3 = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

⇒ 8439x53 divisible by 9 if x = 4

questions.question: In a circle of radius 17 cm, a chord is at a distance of 8 cm from the centre of the circle. What is the length of the chord?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06cd5f30292506ebcc1b72072a571bf5ed46ff14cebdb6cfb1a340b98a771bc.png] 

Let AB is chord and point M is the midpoint of AB, O is the centre.

Given, OM = 8 cm and Radius OB = 17 cm

In ΔOMB

Using Pythagoras theorem

⇒ (OB)² = (OM)² + (MB)²

⇒ 17² = 8² + (MB)²

⇒ MB = √(289 – 64) = 15

As we know, AB = 2 MB

AB = 2 × 15 = 30 cm

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 110° at the centre of the circle. The chord AB is produced to a point P. Then ∠CBP is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56107e6a0e3bf58520b9369646f18866ebdff464721e53a1b4dadde9cc454bcd.png] 

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle is double the size of the angle subtended by the same arc at the circle circumference

Take any point Q on the circumference and join AQ and QC .

∴ ∠AOC = 2 × ∠AQC

⇒ ∠AQC = 1/2 × ∠AOC = 1/2 × 110° = 55°

Now, ∠CBP = ∠AQC [exterior angle of cyclic quadrilateral]

⇒ ∠CBP = 55°

questions.question: The value of sin² 32° + sin² 58° – sin30° + sec²60° is equal to:
questions.solution:
sin² 32° + sin² 58° – sin30° + sec²60°

⇒ sin² 32° + sin² (90 – 32)° – 1/2 + 2²

⇒ sin² 32° + cos²32° – 1/2 + 4 [sin(90 – θ) = cos θ and sin² θ + cos² θ = 1]

⇒ 1 – 1/2 + 4

⇒ 5 – 0.5 = 4.5

questions.question: In ΔABC, P is a point on BC such that BP : PC = 4 : 11. If Q is the midpoint of BP, then ar(ΔABQ) : ar(ABC) is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9e2df662d7c87c6a852f7c00b9ee82e4c310aad0400da63f43ea9b96975f191.png] 

Given, BP : PC = 4 : 11

Suppose BP = 4 unit and PC = 11 unit

BC = BP + PC = 4 + 11 = 15 unit

If Q is the midpoint of BP, then BQ = QP

BQ = BP/2 = 4/2 = 2 unit

ar ΔABQ : ar ΔABC = BQ : BC

ar ΔABQ : ar ΔABC = 2 : 15

Walking at 7/9 of his usual speed, a person reaches his office 10 minutes later than the usual time. His usual time in minutes is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

Time is inversely proportional to speed.

Let the usual speed of the person be 9x

Speed of the person after decreasing = 7x

Ratio of usual speed to after decreasing = 9x : 7x

Ratio of usual time to after decreasing = 7x : 9x

9x – 7x = 10

questions.question: Two articles are sold for Rs. 962 each. On one, the seller gains 30% and on the other he loses 26%. What is his overall gain or loss percentage, nearest to one decimal place?
questions.solution:
SP of each article = Rs. 962

CP of first article = 962 × [100/130] = 740

CP of second article = 962 × [100/74] = 1300

Total SP of both article = 962 × 2 = 1924

Total CP of both article = 740 + 1300 = 2040

Total Loss = 2040 – 1924 = 116

Loss percentage = [116/2040] × 100 = 5.7% (approx)
